SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-22: CQL — Errors and Messaging. Test these items: Message(source, condition, code, severity, message). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §9 (Query where clause filters the returned elements) + Appendix B Errors and Messaging (Message with Error severity and true condition stops evaluation)
issues.evidence: define X: Patient.name N where Message(true, First(N.given) = 'Ann', 'F', 'Error', 'first given not Ann') return N.given — and equally the non-Message form — translated to from_json(fhirpath(_pt.patient_resource,'name.given'),...) with NO where clause: unfiltered givens returned for every patient and the Error-severity Message raise swallowed on BOTH engine paths (py fallback and C++ extension; translation-level).
issues.root_cause: _query.py: WHERE application on a scalar fhirpath_text/fhirpath source CASE-wrapped the whole list, then the RETURN clause's list_transform path (_did_list_transform) discarded that CASE entirely, returning the raw return projection.
issues.resolution: Defer the WHERE to the per-element list path: when the source is fhirpath_text/fhirpath and both where+return exist, translate the where inside the lambda scope and apply list_filter before list_transform (or a WHERE in the UNNEST variant when subqueries are present). Regression test added py+cpp.
issues.verified_in: test_message_parity.py 13/13; master gate 2832/2832 fresh on final tree
